name: Content
description: Blog articles with authors, daily GA4 pageviews, and Search Console clicks and impressions, from Analytics' daily content collection. Reads only Analytics' own tables, so opening it calls no provider.

panels.title: Collection
panels.sql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT step, status, started_at, window_end, error_message FROM ( SELECT step, status, started_at, window_end, error_message, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ) SELECT CASE step WHEN 'builder_blog' THEN 'Blog articles' WHEN 'ga4' THEN 'GA4 pageviews' WHEN 'search_console' THEN 'Search Console' ELSE step END AS source, CASE status WHEN 'succeeded' THEN 'Collected' WHEN 'failed' THEN 'Failed' WHEN 'cost_limited' THEN 'Cost-limited' WHEN 'not_configured' THEN 'Not set up' WHEN 'running' THEN 'Running' ELSE status END AS status, started_at AS last_run, (SELECT window_end FROM analytics_content_collection_runs successful WHERE successful.step = latest.step AND successful.status = 'succeeded' ORDER BY successful.started_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS data_through, error_message AS detail FROM latest ORDER BY CASE step WHEN 'builder_blog' THEN 1 WHEN 'ga4' THEN 2 WHEN 'search_console' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

config.description: Latest run across all time for each source. Data through is the last successful coverage boundary.

panels.title: Articles
panels.sql: WITH latest AS ( SELECT step, status, started_at, window_end, error_message FROM ( SELECT step, status, started_at, window_end, error_message, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY step ORDER BY started_at DESC) AS rn FROM analytics_content_collection_runs ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), totals AS ( SELECT item_id, SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'ga4_pageviews') AS pageviews, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'ga4_pageviews') AS pageview_rows, SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS clicks, SUM(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'search_console_impressions') AS impressions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS search_rows FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots WHERE (metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY item_id ) SELECT title, href, author, published, pageviews, clicks, impressions, NULLIF(COALESCE(ga4_missing, '') || CASE WHEN ga4_missing IS NOT NULL AND search_missing IS NOT NULL THEN ' · ' ELSE '' END || COALESCE(search_missing, ''), '') AS not_collected FROM ( SELECT i.title, i.url AS href, i.author, i.published_at, substr(i.published_at, 1, 10) AS published, t.pageviews, t.clicks, t.impressions, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.pageview_rows, 0) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'GA4: ' || CASE ga4_run.status WHEN 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN 'cost_limited' THEN 'cost-limited' WHEN 'not_configured' THEN 'not set up' WHEN 'running' THEN 'running' WHEN 'succeeded' THEN 'not reported in this window' ELSE 'not collected yet' END END AS ga4_missing, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.search_rows, 0) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'Search Console: ' || CASE search_run.status WHEN 'failed' THEN 'failed' WHEN 'cost_limited' THEN 'cost-limited' WHEN 'not_configured' THEN 'not set up' WHEN 'running' THEN 'running' WHEN 'succeeded' THEN 'not reported in this window' ELSE 'not collected yet' END END AS search_missing FROM analytics_content_items i LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.item_id = i.id LEFT JOIN latest ga4_run ON ga4_run.step = 'ga4' LEFT JOIN latest search_run ON search_run.step = 'search_console' WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' ) articles ORDER BY published_at DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

config.description: The 1,000 most recently published collected blog articles. A blank number means that source has no data for the article in this window; Not collected says why.

panels.title: Daily pageviews and search clicks
panels.sql: WITH RECURSIVE dates AS (SELECT CASE '{{timeRange}}' WHEN '7d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 7 WHEN '28d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 28 WHEN '90d' THEN CURRENT_DATE - 90 WHEN 'custom' THEN NULLIF('{{timeRangeStart}}', '')::date ELSE (SELECT MIN(metric_date)::date FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots) END AS day UNION ALL SELECT day + 1 FROM dates WHERE day < CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE END), totals AS (SELECT s.metric_date AS date, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'ga4_pageviews') AS pageviews, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS search_clicks FROM analytics_content_metric_snapshots s JOIN analytics_content_items i ON i.id = s.item_id WHERE i.source = 'builder_blog' AND s.metric IN ('ga4_pageviews', 'search_console_clicks') AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY s.metric_date ORDER BY s.metric_date) SELECT to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, totals.pageviews, totals.search_clicks FROM dates LEFT JOIN totals ON totals.date = to_char(dates.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE dates.day <= CASE WHEN '{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' THEN LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, NULLIF('{{timeRangeEnd}}', '')::date) ELSE CURRENT_DATE END ORDER BY dates.day

config.description: All blog articles. A day a source hasn't reported is a gap, not a zero.

panels.title: Other pages in search
panels.sql: SELECT i.url AS page, i.url AS href, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_clicks') AS clicks, SUM(s.value) FILTER (WHERE s.metric = 'search_console_impressions') AS impressions FROM analytics_content_items i JOIN analytics_content_metric_snapshots s ON s.item_id = i.id WHERE i.source = 'search_console' AND (s.metric_date <= to_char(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ('{{timeRange}}' IN ('', 'all') OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '7d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '28d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '28 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = '90d' AND s.metric_date >= to_char(CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR ('{{timeRange}}' = 'custom' AND s.metric_date >= '{{timeRangeStart}}' AND s.metric_date <= '{{timeRangeEnd}}'))) GROUP BY i.url ORDER BY clicks DESC NULLS LAST, impressions DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 200

config.description: Search Console pages that aren't collected blog articles.
